items.author: Neighbourhood Policing - Levenshulme (shared by Gaz Whitworth)
items.title: Public safety warning: counterfeit tablets
items.body: We are warning people in south Manchester about blue tablets being sold as diazepam or 'Xanax'. Some have been found to contain nitazenes, synthetic opioids that can be far stronger than heroin. Several people have needed hospital treatment in the last fortnight. Signs include extreme drowsiness, pinpoint pupils, slow or noisy breathing and blue lips. If you are with someone who has taken something and becomes unwell, call 999 immediately. Our priority is preserving life. Please share.

items.title: naloxone
items.body: Brightpath drug & alcohol service, Stockport Rd (next to the launderette). Free nasal naloxone kits, anyone can ask, no names needed. Training takes about 10 mins. Open Mon-Fri 10-4, Thurs till 7.
